mapper.select: select sp.* from SMT_SUPPLIER_PERSON sp join SMT_SECURITYAREA_SUPPLIER ss on sp.SUPPLIER_ID=ss.ID where sp.SUPPLIER_ID=#{supplierId} and sp.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ss.DEL_FLAG = 0

select count(1) from SMT_SUPPLIER_PERSON sp join SMT_SECURITYAREA_SUPPLIER ss on sp.SUPPLIER_ID=ss.ID where sp.SUPPLIER_ID=#{supplierId} and sp.ID_CARD=#{idCard} and sp.DEL_FLAG = 0 and ss.DEL_FLAG = 0
